blocks.display: TCP sets up a connection, numbers data so it can be reassembled, and resends what is lost. Web pages, email, and file transfer use it. UDP sends datagrams without that handshake. blocks.display: A low-level language sits near the processor. Machine code is bits. Assembly replaces some of those bits with short mnemonics. SQLite is a file database that ships with Python and is the right learning tool; MySQL is a server database used when many clients share one store. blocks.display:
import sqlite3
con = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
cur = con.cursor()
cur.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        marks INTEGER
    )
""")
cur.execute("INSERT INTO student (name, marks) VALUES (?, ?)", ("Hina", 82))
con.commit()
rows = cur.execute(
    "SELECT name, marks FROM student WHERE marks >= ?", (50,)
).fetchall()
con.close()
print(rows)
